name: The King's Guild
description: Master artisans of the King's Guild each ply a different trade in a different quarter of the city. Work out who's who.
clues: Either Carpenter goes with Earl, or Bridgegate goes with Duke — but not both.
If Highrow goes with Prince, then Rowan goes with Cooper.
Prince goes with exactly two of Cedric, Weaver, and Millpond.
At least one of no one in the Joiners' Guild goes with Aldric, Millpond goes with Prince, or Duke goes with Tanner if and only if Cedric goes with Earl.
Either Aldric goes with Tanner or someone in the River Ward goes with Tanner (but not both).
Between Aldric and Prince, one goes with Bridgegate and the other with Highrow.
Aldric goes with exactly two of Carpenter, Bridgegate, and Duke.
